deck.title: Harness Workflow: 把 Agent 工作变成可恢复、可验证、可交接的工程系统
deck.audience: 已经知道 Codex / Claude Code / Cursor，但还不理解 harness engineering 和本插件 workflow skill 设计的项目维护者、使用者和未来协作者。

style.description: High-density editorial technical deck. White or near-white canvas, deep ink text, cyan-green accent, restrained amber warning accent. Use crisp system diagrams, lane maps, evidence chains, compact matrices, and workbench/control-room metaphors. Slides must be vivid through structure and visual explanation, not decorative stock imagery. Chinese-first typography, readable large headings, dense but organized body panels.
style.typography: Chinese-first sans-serif style similar to Microsoft YaHei / Noto Sans CJK. Use bold section titles, compact labels, and table-like information blocks. Avoid tiny unreadable paragraphs.
style.chart_style: clean consulting/research charts with legible labels
style.page_number_policy: Use a consistent small bottom-right page/total footer on every slide except the cover: 02/16 through 16/16.
style.visible_text_policy: Do not render asset ids, filenames, file paths, source labels, protocol metadata, parser labels, or internal evidence labels. Render only reader-facing Chinese content.

page_list.title: Harness Workflow
page_list.claim: 这不是 prompt 包，而是让 Agent 在真实仓库里可靠工作的项目级操作系统。

page_list.title: 为什么能力强的 Agent 仍会失败
page_list.claim: 失败通常不是模型不会写代码，而是仓库周围缺少可恢复、可验证、可约束的工作环境。

page_list.title: Harness Engineering: 围绕 Agent 的工程系统
page_list.claim: Harness 是模型周围的运行环境：指令、状态、反馈、工具和收尾纪律共同决定可靠性。

page_list.title: C1-C10: 稳定方法论合同
page_list.claim: skill 名称可以演进，但 C1-C10 规定了这个插件必须长期守住的工程原则。

page_list.title: Workflow Lanes: 不是流水线，而是路由系统
page_list.claim: 每个 skill 是一个活动车道；根据当前状态路由，不要求所有任务按固定顺序走完。

page_list.title: Skill Independence: 解耦设计
page_list.claim: skill 之间靠语义输出交接，而不是共享一个固定文件布局或固定执行序列。

page_list.title: harness-builder: 先修工作面
page_list.claim: 当项目入口、验证命令、恢复面或能力边界不清楚时，先构建最小有用的项目 harness。

page_list.title: brainstorm + plan: 从想法到可执行合同
page_list.claim: 先把要建什么和如何证明说清，再把它切成唯一 active slice 和 commit-sized work units。

page_list.title: implement + diagnose: 执行与失败处理
page_list.claim: 实现时 WIP=1；失败不靠猜，必须复现、假设、验证根因再修复。

page_list.title: review + verify: 判断与证明分开
page_list.claim: review 判断是否正确、越界、缺证据；verify 用当前命令和证据证明 ready claim。

page_list.title: cleanup + find-skills: 防熵增与能力适配
page_list.claim: 收尾要让项目知识回到真实状态；能力发现只服务真实缺口，不是囤工具。

page_list.title: Recovery Surface: 后端是选择，不是信仰
page_list.claim: 恢复面保存语义字段；none、docs plan、issue、feature list、three-file 或 existing system 都可以是合理后端。

page_list.title: 常见路由: 按状态选 skill
page_list.claim: 正确路线来自当前证据状态，而不是固定仪式感。

page_list.title: 一次真实工作如何穿过 Harness
page_list.claim: 从用户请求到交付，关键不是多跑几个 skill，而是每一步都留下可恢复和可验证的工件。

page_list.title: 读者应该带走的操作清单
page_list.claim: 可靠 Agent 工作的最低标准：范围清楚、仓库为真、证据新鲜、状态可恢复、收尾不留熵。

page_list.title: Reference Map: 每个 skill 的责任边界
page_list.claim: 八个 active workflow skills 加一个辅助发现 skill，共同覆盖从构思到收尾的工程闭环。

assets.caption: The approved executable plan requires a dense, vivid, reader-useful PPT explaining why the skills exist, Harness Engineering design intent, each active skill's actual job, and non-rigid skill cooperation.
assets.usage: deck scope, slide sequence, success criteria, output and verification plan

assets.caption: Harness Workflow is a context-aware agent workbench for real repositories. It gives agents repo evidence, requirement context, recovery state, and verification discipline for work that does not fit in one chat.
assets.usage: title thesis, pain points, practical harness explanation, skill map, common routes

assets.caption: Defines canonical terms: Harness Builder, Skill Independence, Capability Discovery, Recovery Surface, Workflow State Backend, Executable Plan, Spec, Review, Verification, and Knowledge Cleanup. It warns against treating bootstrap, three-file state, or fixed sequencing as universal.

C1-C10 stable method contract: harness as system, repo as truth, thin instructions, workbench before implementation, scoped work, fresh evidence, capability fit, artifact freshness, knowledge cleanup, and backend decoupling.
assets.usage: method contract, principle matrix, verification criteria

assets.caption: Harness Builder collects repo evidence, reconciles existing harnesses, writes a Harness Charter, builds a Coverage Matrix, runs Capability Discovery, selects packs when justified, and verifies project-local harness changes.
assets.usage: harness-builder slide, coverage matrix, capability fit

assets.caption: Brainstorm turns fuzzy intent into an approved Spec with goals, non-goals, options and verification strategy. Plan turns a clear request or Spec into an Executable Plan with active slice, success criteria, verification path, risks and commit units.

Implement executes one scoped slice with WIP=1 and risk-matched checks. Diagnose handles unexplained failures through reproduce, minimize, hypothesis, instrumentation, root cause, fix and regression evidence.

Review checks correctness, scope, evidence gaps, docs drift and entropy before ready claims. Verify maps a concrete ready claim to fresh evidence using an evidence ladder and routes failure to diagnose.
Cleanup reconciles docs, generated artifacts and recovery surface to prevent knowledge rot. Find-skills is an auxiliary discovery helper for reusable capabilities, not a ninth active workflow lane.

format_contract: Every slide is one complete 16:9 full-slide PNG unless the protocol says otherwise.
All visible title, claim, labels, chart text, captions, and logos must be rendered inside the PNG.
Do not create a blank background, prompt-only handoff, SVG, HTML screenshot, or later PowerPoint text overlay.
Use the same visual system, typography, palette, density, margins, and hierarchy across all pages.
Use one consistent page number/footer policy across the deck; do not randomly add page numbers to only some pages.
Do not invent or alter facts, numbers, curves, table headers, logos, or captions on strict_embed pages.
negative_contract: No visible asset ids, filenames, file paths, source labels, protocol field names, or 'source: ... table' metadata.
No decorative clutter that breaks the confirmed deck style.
style_lock.worker_rule: Every worker prompt must include this style_lock verbatim plus only the assigned protocol page slice. Forked chat history is never the source of truth for visual consistency.

worker_dispatch.reason: 7+ confirmed pages require bounded image-generation subagent dispatch before direct generation fallback
worker_dispatch.medium_escalation_rule: strict_embed, dense table/scientific evidence, multiple reference assets, prior failure, or explicit user extra-care request

pages.title: Harness Workflow
pages.prompt: Design a finished 16:9 Chinese title slide. Visible title: Harness Workflow. Subtitle: 把 Agent 工作变成可恢复、可验证、可交接的工程系统. Use a vivid but professional workbench/control-room metaphor: central agent console surrounded by five labeled subsystems: 入口规则, 仓库真相, 状态恢复, 新鲜证据, 知识收尾. Include a compact thesis strip: 不是 prompt 包 / 不是固定流程 / 是 repo-local operating system. High-density but clean, no decorative emptiness.
pages.negative_prompt: No stock-photo people, no magic robot, no visible file paths, no source labels, no metadata, no watermarks, no tiny unreadable text, no purple gradient, no dark-only cyber theme.
pages.speaker_notes: 开场先把定位讲清楚：这个插件不是把几句提示词打包，而是把 agent 在真实仓库里需要的入口、证据、状态、验证和收尾变成一套可以执行的工作面。下一页解释为什么这种系统必要。

pages.title: 为什么能力强的 Agent 仍会失败
pages.prompt: Create a dense diagnostic map slide in Chinese. Left side: six failure symptoms in compact cards: stale docs, unclear scope, dirty git state, missing tests, context compaction, weak ready claims. Right side: missing harness component for each symptom: project map, active slice, recovery surface, verification entry, evidence log, cleanup discipline. Bottom bar: 核心判断: Agent 质量 = 模型能力 + 仓库周围的系统. Use arrows, warning amber accents, and cyan-green solution labels.
pages.negative_prompt: No generic AI failure slogans, no fake metrics, no visible repository paths, no internal asset ids, no long paragraphs, no unreadable microtext.
pages.speaker_notes: 这一页把问题从“模型聪不聪明”转到“工作环境是否足够工程化”。强调这些失败在真实仓库里反复出现，所以需要 harness，而不是再加一段万能 prompt。

pages.title: Harness Engineering: 围绕 Agent 的工程系统

pages.title: Skill Independence: 解耦设计
pages.prompt: Design a coupling-boundary slide in Chinese. Use a three-column model: Activity Lane, Canonical Output, Next Routing. Rows: brainstorm->Spec, plan->Executable Plan, implement->scoped change with evidence, diagnose->root cause, review->findings, verify->fresh evidence, cleanup->aligned artifacts. Add side panel: Recovery Surface can be none, lightweight, docs plan, issue, feature list, three-file, existing system. Big note: 语义字段 > 固定文件布局.

pages.title: harness-builder: 先修工作面
pages.prompt: Create a dense Harness Builder slide in Chinese. Main visual: Coverage Matrix mini-table with rows: project map, durable rules, recovery surface, verification entry, architecture boundaries, anti-entropy, capability fit, dynamic context. Flow across top: repo evidence -> Harness Charter -> Coverage Matrix -> Capability Discovery -> phased install -> fresh verification. Include output chips: AGENTS.md thin entry, docs/agent, .harness, project-local skills, checks. State clearly: 不是空模板生成器.

pages.speaker_notes: 说明 harness-builder 不是每次都必须跑，但当工作面缺失时它是最关键的基础设施 skill。它的核心不是写文件，而是先建立证据、合同和覆盖矩阵。

pages.title: brainstorm + plan: 从想法到可执行合同
pages.prompt: Design a two-stage funnel slide in Chinese. Left: fuzzy intent with questions: goal, boundary, user, constraints, success, verification. Middle: Spec with goals/non-goals/options/rejected options/verification strategy. Right: Executable Plan with active slice, success criteria, verification path, phases, risks, commit units. Add warning: plan 不负责补问需求; 需求不清回 brainstorm. Include small example phrase: “制作 workflow PPT” -> deck plan.
pages.negative_prompt: No implying brainstorm writes implementation code, no source metadata, no huge paragraphs, no generic planning stock icons.
pages.speaker_notes: 这一页把需求收敛和实施计划分开。brainstorm 解决模糊性，plan 解决可执行性。两者都必须提前考虑验证，而不是最后才想怎么证明。

worker_context.prompt_contract: Use the same style_lock for every page; forked chat history is supplemental only.

pages.title: implement + diagnose: 执行与失败处理
pages.prompt: Create a split-loop slide in Chinese. Left green loop: implement = confirm active slice -> minimal step -> focused check -> minimal change -> adjacent verification -> docs/recovery sync. Right red loop: diagnose = capture failure -> reproduce twice -> minimize -> one hypothesis -> instrument -> root cause -> regression evidence. Center rule: 连续失败或根因不清，转 diagnose. Use contrasting green/red lanes with compact checklists.
pages.negative_prompt: No chaotic bug imagery, no fake stack traces, no source labels, no tiny unreadable command output, no oversized decorative icons.
pages.speaker_notes: 这里强调 implementation 和 diagnosis 的边界。正常红绿循环里的红是预期；不明失败、命令异常或错误变化才进入 diagnose。

worker_context.prompt_contract: Use the same style_lock for every page; forked chat history is supplemental only.

pages.title: review + verify: 判断与证明分开
pages.prompt: Design a two-gate quality slide in Chinese. Gate 1: review checks Spec coverage, correctness, evidence gap, docs/artifacts, entropy; outputs Pass/Conditional/Block. Gate 2: verify checks ready claim against evidence ladder: static parse, build, typecheck, lint, unit, integration, smoke, E2E, manual signal. Big distinction: review judges; verify proves. Add route labels: finding -> implement/diagnose; failing evidence -> diagnose; pass -> cleanup.
pages.negative_prompt: No confusing review with testing, no source metadata, no fake checkmarks without evidence, no unreadable ladder text.
pages.speaker_notes: 这页让读者记住两个门的分工：review 是结构性判断，verify 是 fresh evidence。没有当前证据不能说 ready。

worker_context.prompt_contract: Use the same style_lock for every page; forked chat history is supplemental only.

Left: Knowledge Cleanup checklist: README current, AGENTS thin, generated artifacts regenerated, recovery surface aligned, residual drift recorded, no hiding unfinished work. Right: Capability Fit card for find-skills: value, enablement, risk/cost, fallback; helper for Capability Discovery, not ninth workflow lane. pages.title: Recovery Surface: 后端是选择，不是信仰

Under it show backend options as cards: none, lightweight, docs plan, issue tracker, feature list, three-file, existing system. Add decision rule strip: 任务越长/风险越高/协作越多 -> 越需要 durable recovery. pages.title: 常见路由: 按状态选 skill
pages.prompt: Create a route cookbook slide in Chinese. Use six compact route cards: Tiny edit: implement -> verify. Unclear feature: brainstorm -> plan -> harness-builder -> implement -> review -> verify -> cleanup. Clear task unfamiliar repo: plan -> harness-builder -> implement -> review -> verify. Broken command: diagnose -> implement -> verify. Harness audit: harness-builder -> verify -> cleanup. Research route: brainstorm -> plan -> harness-builder -> bounded evidence loop -> review -> verify -> cleanup. Use small arrows and condition badges.
pages.negative_prompt: No one giant unreadable flowchart, no rigid mandatory pipeline framing, no source labels, no decorative empty space.
pages.speaker_notes: 这一页把前面的抽象原则转成使用手册。读者应该能看到：不同任务状态对应不同路线，workflow 是帮助少走弯路，不是增加步骤。

pages.title: 一次真实工作如何穿过 Harness
